item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00179","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C02","C10"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 plausibly supplied a material emergency-action template. Both directives begin with statutory authority and the December 16, 1950 national-emergency proclamation, identify enemy or hostile attack as the triggering contingency, and then authorize an agency to take specified defensive action when that contingency occurs. The child substantially compresses and adapts C08's machinery from emergency control of radio stations to emergency release of strategic stockpiles. C02 and C10 share disposition language—particularly transfers upon terms and conditions determined by a designated director—but their foreign-relief setting and memorandum structure make them weaker templates.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS the existence of a national emergency with respect to common defense has been proclaimed by the President by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS the existence of a national emergency has been proclaimed by the President by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950","explanation":"Distinctive shared recital invoking the same emergency proclamation as the legal and factual foundation."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS an enemy attack on the continental United States might create shortages ... requiring immediate release","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS it is necessary ... that plans be prepared and implemented ... in the event of hostile action endangering the nation, or imminent threat thereof","explanation":"Both frame the order around advance administrative machinery for immediate action upon enemy attack."},{"child_excerpt":"In the event of enemy attack upon the continental United States ... the Director ... is authorized and directed to order the release","parent_excerpt":"The authority ... is hereby delegated to the Federal Communications Commission ... for preparing and putting into effect plans ... in event of attack or of imminent threat thereof","explanation":"Parallel operative structure delegates emergency authority to a named official or agency, conditioned on attack, to direct control over strategically important resources."}]}
